#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# deploy.sh - Create a release archive (tar.gz) of the current directory.
#
# Excludes:
#   - node_modules/
#   - .git/
#   - The release archive itself (so it doesn't recursively include itself)
#
# Usage:
#   ./deploy.sh [release_name]
#
# Example:
#   ./deploy.sh                  # Creates <dirname>-<timestamp>.tar.gz
#   ./deploy.sh myapp-v1.0.0     # Creates myapp-v1.0.0.tar.gz

set -euo pipefail

# --- Configuration ---------------------------------------------------------

# Directory we are archiving (current working directory).
SOURCE_DIR="$(pwd)"
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$SOURCE_DIR")"

# Build a default release name from the project name and a timestamp.
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
RELEASE_NAME="${1:-${PROJECT_NAME}-${TIMESTAMP}}"

# Strip a trailing .tar.gz if the user supplied one, then append it ourselves.
RELEASE_NAME="${RELEASE_NAME%.tar.gz}"
ARCHIVE_FILE="${RELEASE_NAME}.tar.gz"

# Place the archive in the parent directory so it is not included in itself.
OUTPUT_PATH="$(cd .. && pwd)/${ARCHIVE_FILE}"

# --- Pre-flight checks -----------------------------------------------------

if ! command -v tar >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Error: 'tar' is not installed or not in PATH." >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [[ -e "$OUTPUT_PATH" ]]; then
    echo "Error: Archive already exists: $OUTPUT_PATH" >&2
    echo "Remove it first or choose a different release name." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# --- Build the archive -----------------------------------------------------

echo "==> Creating release archive"
echo "    Project : $PROJECT_NAME"
echo "    Source  : $SOURCE_DIR"
echo "    Output  : $OUTPUT_PATH"
echo

# Run tar from the parent directory so the archive contains a top-level
# folder named after the project, which is friendlier when extracted.
cd ..

tar \
    --exclude="${PROJECT_NAME}/node_modules" \
    --exclude="${PROJECT_NAME}/.git" \
    --exclude="${PROJECT_NAME}/${ARCHIVE_FILE}" \
    -czf "$OUTPUT_PATH" \
    "$PROJECT_NAME"

# --- Report ----------------------------------------------------------------

ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -h "$OUTPUT_PATH" | cut -f1)"
echo
echo "==> Release built successfully"
echo "    File : $OUTPUT_PATH"
echo "    Size : $ARCHIVE_SIZE"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# deploy.sh - Create a release archive (tar.gz) of the current directory.
#
# Excludes: node_modules, .git, and any previously generated release archives.
# Usage:    ./deploy.sh [output_directory]
#

set -euo pipefail

# ---- Configuration ---------------------------------------------------------

# Name of the project (defaults to the current directory name)
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"

# Timestamp for unique release naming (e.g. 20240521-143055)
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"

# Output directory (first arg, or ./releases by default)
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-./releases}"

# Final archive path
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# ---- Helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------

log()  { printf '\033[1;34m[deploy]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
err()  { printf '\033[1;31m[error]\033[0m  %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

# ---- Pre-flight checks -----------------------------------------------------

if ! command -v tar >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    err "tar is not installed or not in PATH."
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"

# ---- Build the archive -----------------------------------------------------

log "Project:  ${PROJECT_NAME}"
log "Archive:  ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
log "Creating release archive..."

# We run tar from the parent directory so the archive contains a top-level
# folder named after the project (a common convention for releases).
PARENT_DIR="$(dirname "$(pwd)")"
SOURCE_DIR="$(basename "$(pwd)")"

# Resolve absolute output path before changing directories
ABS_OUTPUT_DIR="$(cd "${OUTPUT_DIR}" && pwd)"
ABS_ARCHIVE_PATH="${ABS_OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

tar \
    --exclude="${SOURCE_DIR}/node_modules" \
    --exclude="${SOURCE_DIR}/.git" \
    --exclude="${SOURCE_DIR}/releases" \
    --exclude='*.log' \
    --exclude='.DS_Store' \
    -czf "${ABS_ARCHIVE_PATH}" \
    -C "${PARENT_DIR}" \
    "${SOURCE_DIR}"

# ---- Report ----------------------------------------------------------------

ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -h "${ABS_ARCHIVE_PATH}" | cut -f1)"
log "Done! Created ${ARCHIVE_PATH} (${ARCHIVE_SIZE})"
